categories.main_business_segments: Transaction Co., Ltd. operates as a pure holding company overseeing a group focused on the planning, design, production (mainly outsourced), quality control, and sales of a wide range of consumer goods. Its main business segments are classified by product type: Eco Products (environmentally friendly items), Lifestyle Products (general miscellaneous goods), Wellness Products (health and hygiene-related goods), and Design/Other (design and printing services). The group provides both custom-made products for corporate end-users and original products for wholesalers, as well as e-commerce sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company adopts a fabless manufacturing model, focusing on product planning, design, and development while outsourcing production to over 600 partner factories, mainly in Asia. It utilizes a 'mobile fabless' approach, flexibly shifting production to optimal locations based on cost, quality, and risk. Key technologies include advanced printing (such as silk screen and on-demand printing), rapid product development, and the integration of sustainable materials (recycled, upcycled, and certified eco-materials) into product lines.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are corporate clients seeking custom promotional goods, wholesalers purchasing original branded products, and end-users via e-commerce. Key end markets include the entertainment (IP/character goods), retail, promotional/marketing, travel, and wellness sectors. The company also targets the growing 'fan activity' (Oshikatsu) market, as well as inbound tourism and pet-related markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The group’s main operations and sales are concentrated in Japan, with production and quality control activities extending across China and other Asian countries. It has subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Shanghai, and the US (California), supporting overseas production, quality management, and market research. While over 90% of sales are domestic, the company is expanding e-commerce and IP-related sales internationally.
categories.supply_chain_position: Transaction operates as a midstream player, focusing on product planning, design, and sales, while outsourcing manufacturing to upstream suppliers (factories). It manages quality control and logistics, acting as an integrator between manufacturers and downstream customers (corporates, wholesalers, and end-users).
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding e-commerce (aiming to 2.5x sales in 5 years), developing IP/entertainment-related products, deepening eco and disaster-prevention product lines, and pursuing M&A for new categories and value chain integration. R&D emphasizes sustainable materials, rapid trend adaptation, and digital transformation (AI/DX) for operational efficiency and new business creation. The company is also committed to sustainability, climate action, and human capital development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of physical products (custom and original goods) to corporate clients, wholesalers, and end-users via e-commerce. Additional revenue streams include design and printing services, as well as licensing and sales of IP/character goods. The company also receives management and service fees from subsidiaries.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Transaction positions itself as a leading fabless manufacturer and integrator in the Japanese promotional and lifestyle goods market, with a strong focus on eco and trend-driven products. Major competitors include other B2B promotional goods suppliers, OEM/ODM manufacturers, and companies specializing in eco-friendly or IP-related merchandise. The company differentiates itself through its integrated value chain, rapid product development, and sustainability leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending August 2025, consolidated net sales reached ¥27.45 billion (approx. $180 million), with operating profit of ¥5.7 billion and net profit of ¥4.08 billion. The company has shown steady growth, with sales increasing by 9.6% year-on-year and profits reaching record highs. The group employs 495 people (plus 198 temporary staff) and maintains a strong financial position with high equity ratio and low debt.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Transaction emphasizes rapid, trend-responsive product development, high customization capabilities, and strong sustainability credentials (eco-materials, certified products, and climate initiatives). Its fabless, mobile production model enables flexibility, cost efficiency, and risk mitigation. The company also leverages digital platforms for customer convenience and operational efficiency, and positions itself as a trusted partner for both corporate clients and wholesalers seeking innovative, sustainable, and high-quality goods.
